fold_marks.source: en.wikipedia "Arabic diacritics": "short vowels and consonant length are not generally indicated in writing. Tashkīl is optional to represent missing vowels and consonant length."; "The bulk of Arabic script is written without ḥarakāt". Harakat, shadda and tanwin are tashkil.

kept_marks.source: en.wikipedia "Arabic diacritics": "the hamza هَمْزة ( hamzah , glottal stop ), often stands as a separate letter in writing, is written in unpointed texts and is not considered a tashkīl .
